Provides a post-processing filter that applies a configurable sharpening effect to a rendered image using a shader-based approach.

Remarks

The SharpenFX class is intended for use within a post-processing stack to enhance image clarity by increasing edge contrast. It exposes several preset configurations for common sharpening strengths, as well as an adjustable Intensity property for custom tuning. The effect is applied by rendering to an internal render target using a dedicated shader. This class manages its own resources and must be initialized and disposed of appropriately within the rendering pipeline.
